tasks.short: Keep informed about education and vocational trends

steps.what: Find current sources on education and subject matter specialties

loop.purpose: Match current professional sources to teacher-selected interests
loop.input: Teacher topic brief and actual source titles, abstracts or descriptions
loop.output: Shortlist with source links and specific relevance explanations
loop.check: Teacher opens sources and verifies topic coverage, publication date and credibility rather than trusting the summary
loop.stop: One revision then manual search if links or relevance cannot be verified
loop.why_not_simpler: Keyword alerts miss relevant terminology across educational and occupational sources

steps.what: Read, discuss and assess trends for their educational and occupational relevance

tasks.design: Try native {DOCS} search and professional-source alerts before a bounded relevance shortlist. Keep reading, discussion and judgement with the teacher; a shortlist does not count as professional learning completed.
tasks.previous_blocker: Relevant developments use different terms across education and occupational practice.
tasks.enabler_now: A bounded matching step can identify actual sources for review.
tasks.still_hard: A new industry claim may be promotional or unsuitable for the course.
tasks.human_edge: Judge what a development means for students' real occupational preparation.
tasks.altitude: Less source discovery; professional judgement and learning time remain unchanged.

evidence.claim: Verified relevance shortlisting is an E1 design without measured vocational-teacher evidence in the digest.

assumptions: Boundary is professional source discovery and critical learning, excluding later curriculum revision and classroom implementation.

The teacher enters topic, occupational context, language and recency needs within ten retained s1 hours. Sources supply existing titles and descriptions; unavailable or unverifiable material requires manual search.
Test native search and alerts first. All 80 reading and assessment hours remain; no generated summary substitutes for source review.
unknowns: Existing source access and discovery burden
research_questions: Does a verified shortlist reduce search time while retaining credible and varied occupational sources?

incremental.description: Maintain source access and relevance guidance

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=10+80=90; gross 10%, minus three upkeep gives 7% central net. Low assumes four discovery hours removed; source reading and professional evaluation remain full.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Plan suitable work-experience programs and agree learning and safety responsibilities
Arrange placement dates, supervisor contacts and review appointments
Supervise work experience and discuss progress and concerns with participants

tasks.design: Reuse the agreed placement plan through native {CALENDAR} invitations and {EMAIL} templates. Keep suitability discussions, safety responsibilities, final arrangement confirmation and all supervision with the teacher.
tasks.previous_blocker: Agreed dates and contacts are copied into several coordination messages.
tasks.enabler_now: Native invitation and message templates can reuse those details.
tasks.still_hard: A workplace may be available without providing suitable learning or supervision.
tasks.human_edge: Recognise when a placement is failing the student and negotiate appropriate support.
tasks.altitude: Slightly less arrangement correspondence; placement responsibility remains unchanged.

evidence.claim: Native arrangement templates can reduce repeated placement correspondence; this is E1 model knowledge without a measured digest case.

assumptions: Boundary is this teacher's placement planning, arrangements and supervision. Workplace staff supervision and student work remain outside the focal denominator and unchanged.

The teacher produces student and supervisor contact IDs, placement dates, location, learning goals and review timing in s1 and retained s2 time. All 35 planning hours and 7.5 arrangement hours remain for capture, checks and exceptions.

Availability is agreed through the existing workplace conversation; no new employer form is required. Missing safety responsibilities or unsuitable supervision blocks confirmation and returns to manual discussion.
Test native invitations and saved messages before custom code. Formal placement contract production is outside the task and unchanged.
unknowns: Current arrangement burden and workplace coordination process
research_questions: Can templates remove repeated entry without transferring work to workplace supervisors?

already_counted.description: Placement planning, arrangement capture and confirmation

incremental.description: Maintain arrangement templates and contact exceptions

approvals.approved_version: Exact student, workplace, supervisor, dates and review invitations consistent with the agreed plan; changes require reconfirmation

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=35+7.5+50=92.5; gross 7.5%, minus two upkeep gives 5.5% central net. Low assumes three correspondence hours removable; suitability planning and supervision remain full.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Discuss student needs and progress with professionals

steps.what: Meet with other professionals to discuss students' needs and progress

tasks.design: Keep professional consultation and support agreement with the teacher, informed by existing records in {LMS}. No automatic meeting summary, student score or new administrative process is proposed.
tasks.previous_blocker: Participants must reconcile observations from different settings.
tasks.enabler_now: Existing records already support the human discussion.
tasks.still_hard: A student may appear competent in one context and struggle in another.
tasks.human_edge: Explain observed practice and translate professional advice into workable support.
tasks.altitude: Consultation time and support responsibility remain unchanged.

evidence.claim: Professional discussion retains all labour; no meeting paperwork baseline is invented.

assumptions: Boundary is this teacher's professional consultation, excluding original record capture and specialists' separate work.
No new structured support label or automated decision is required.
Existing native record access is sufficient. No new system or maintenance is added, justifying zero incremental upkeep.
research_questions: Are agreed responsibilities specific enough to guide support in the workshop and classroom?

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=100; zero gross saving and zero upkeep. Professional discussion remains fully counted.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Prepare and implement remedial vocational programmes

steps.what: Prepare remedial programs for teacher-established practical learning gaps

loop.purpose: Adapt approved practical activities to the teacher's specified learning gap
loop.input: Selected skill, observed difficulty, approved tasks and safe practice constraints
loop.output: Draft remedial sequence with target-skill and source links
loop.check: Teacher verifies the tasks practise the actual gap, preserve safety prerequisites and fit the student's demonstrated starting point
loop.stop: One revision then manual planning if suitability or safety is uncertain
loop.why_not_simpler: An activity bank does not always provide the needed explanation and progression for a specific practical gap

steps.what: Implement remedial practice and adapt support to the student's response

tasks.design: Use approved {DOCS} practice tasks first, with a bounded draft to adapt instructions and progression to the teacher's identified gap. The teacher approves safety and suitability and retains all direct remedial support.
tasks.previous_blocker: Suitable practice activities often need instructions and progression rewritten for a specific difficulty.
tasks.enabler_now: Source-limited adaptation can assist that writing without diagnosing the student.
tasks.still_hard: A written plan may not match the student's actual technique or confidence.
tasks.human_edge: Observe the attempt and choose the next helpful demonstration or prompt.
tasks.altitude: Less remedial-plan drafting; diagnosis of the gap and direct support remain with the teacher.

reach.task: Adapt support for persistent practical learning barriers

evidence.claim: LessonUp supports level-based lesson-text rewriting; this supports adaptation assistance rather than automated remedial diagnosis or delivery.
The vocational remedial-plan design and time allowance are E1 model knowledge.

assumptions: Boundary is remedial-plan preparation and delivery after the teacher identifies the gap; ordinary teaching and formal assessment are assigned elsewhere.

The teacher captures the skill reference, concrete observed difficulty, starting prerequisites, selected sources and tool constraints in 18 retained s1 hours, including correction and approval. No structured diagnosis or new student profile is assumed.
Test native activity banks and templates first. Missing safety or source support requires manual planning, and all 70 delivery hours remain.
unknowns: Approved remedial resources and current preparation time
research_questions: Does the adapted plan practise the identified gap safely while reducing writing after correction?

already_counted.description: Gap brief capture, draft correction and suitability approval

incremental.description: Maintain approved task guidance and inspect adaptation errors

approvals.approved_version: Exact remedial tasks, target skill, progression, equipment and safety prerequisites; edits require renewed approval

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=18+70=88; gross 12%, minus three upkeep gives 9% central net. Low assumes five drafting hours removable where adaptation needs substantial correction; all direct support remains full.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: Reduce source discovery, placement correspondence and remedial-plan wording while retaining professional learning, supervision and student support.
reach: Coordinate suitable workplace practice with training supervisors
role.ambitious_version: A vocational teacher with less repeated coordination and more attention available for actual student practice.
